name: Certified Kubernetes Administrator

fee.note: Published exam-only price; includes two exam attempts, two exam-simulator sessions and 12 months to schedule. Bundles with a course or a subscription cost more.

exam.format: Online, proctored, performance-based exam: 15–20 tasks solved at a command line running Kubernetes (v1.37 at the time of checking), in two hours. No prerequisites.

access.retake: One free retake is included if the first attempt is not passed; it must be taken within the 12 months of eligibility that start at purchase, with no enforced wait beyond scoring (up to 24 hours) and the 24-hour booking lead time.
access.accommodations: Candidates with disabilities send the Test Accommodations Form at least two weeks before the exam, before scheduling it; requests are reviewed case by case.

scope: Installing, configuring and running Kubernetes clusters: cluster architecture, workloads and scheduling, services and networking, storage and troubleshooting, tested at the command line.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: The exam environment moves to each new Kubernetes minor version within about 4–8 weeks of its release. The curriculum PDF linked from the certification page is the older v1.35 file; the CNCF repository's v1.37 curriculum has the same weights.
Exam tasks are shown in English, Japanese or Simplified Chinese, and candidates can switch language during the exam.

prep.title: Linux Foundation: Kubernetes Fundamentals (LFS258)
prep.note: Designed as preparation for the CKA; also sold in a bundle with the exam.

prep.title: Killer.sh CKA simulator
prep.note: Two 36-hour sessions of 17 graded questions are included with the exam registration.

domains_note: Weights from the Linux Foundation certification page, 'Domains & Competencies' section, read 2026-11-17; the CNCF CKA curriculum v1.37 PDF gives the same weights.
